title: Trust Acknowledgement
description: This organization's acceptance of a grant another organization published: 'we accept the grant `grantor` gave to `agent_url`, as published via `via`.' Terms are read ONLY from the grantor's document and are never restated here. Not needed when the grantor has the same eTLD+1 as the host serving this document. In the AdCP profile with via 'adcp:adagents' this is intended to supersede brand.json properties[] entries whose relationship is direct, delegated, or ad_network in a future release; brand.json is unchanged in 3.3.

grantor.description: The organization that published the grant.

agent_url.description: The granted agent. MUST match an agents[] entry in this same document by canonical origin; an acknowledgement for an agent this organization does not run is invalid and MUST be ignored.

via.description: Where the grant is published. For 'adcp:adagents', verifiers resolve https://{grantor}/.well-known/adagents.json (following authoritative_location and managed-network rules) and require an authorized_agents[] entry whose canonical url equals agent_url and that reaches the grantor under the reachable-publisher rule. One acknowledgement covers every entry for that agent URL, whatever its authorization_type. The adagents.json comparison is by canonical URL, as that file defines (see docs/reference/url-canonicalization.mdx), not by origin.

delegation_type.description: Optional operator-side assertion of the commercial relationship, for sellers.json-style cross-checking. When present it MUST equal the publisher's delegation_type; a mismatch fails the acknowledgement (state 'mismatch'). Omit to defer entirely to the publisher.
